generation_config.input_convention: pre-command obs7 + previous executed normalized action4

dataset.transition_rule: o_t=inputs[t,:7], a_t=actions[t], next=inputs[t+1,:7]; within episode only

architecture.transition:
ResidualTransition(
  (head): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=68, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (1): Tanh()
    (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (3): Tanh()
    (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=64, bias=True)
  )
)
architecture.decoder:
ObservationDecoder(
  (head): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (1): Tanh()
    (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (3): Tanh()
    (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=7, bias=True)
  )
)

comparison.latent_comparison_limit: Native scale-aware errors, rawL2 and Decoder ratios use different learned latent geometries; not cross-model physical quantities.

objective: Lobs=uniform mean k0..10 observation-std MSE; Lcons=uniform local k0..9 fixedinitialTrainstd MSE(T(E(history_k),a_k)-stopgrad(E(history_k+1))); Ltotal=Lobs+0.1Lcons
stop_gradient: next real-history Encoder output detached only on target side; source Encoder+T gradients enabled; D absent from consistency graph
protocol: same original observation forward; distinct training-only consistency real-history branch; inference is prefixE then T-only recursion/Dreadout, never future E/obs/latent input
limitations: Single seed nominal simulation recorded actions overlapping windows; fixedlambda.1 and local-only consistency, no sweep.
Moving online Encoder reference with targetstopgrad, no EMA/targetnetwork; one modified objective only.
Native latent scales/geometry differ acrossmodels; absolute latent RMSE/Decoder ratio not physical coordinate-invariant comparisons.
Relative residual epsilon is rawcoordinate-dependent; nearstationary denominators can dominate means.
Periodic corrections inject realhistory diagnostically; PCA/covariance are distribution proxies, not proof of nonlinear manifold.

analysis.outcome: Local discrepancy improved, but the proposed local-consistency remedy did not improve autonomous observation prediction. Do not accept v2 as an improved baseline.
analysis.local_comparison_limit: Own-Train latent coordinates are model-dependent; local raw L2 and relative residual median also improve, but none is a strictly coordinate-invariant physical metric.
analysis.relative_local_residual_interpretation: All-sample median falls 1.570927 to 1.072854; moving-reference median falls 1.371499 to 1.028195. Means are dominated by near-stationary denominators; stationary counts differ 2624 versus1094. Do not overinterpret mean reduction.
analysis.observation_tradeoff: All five horizon errors worsen despite improved local consistency. H50 horizontal velocity worsens11.78%; yaw improves13.78%. Reconstruction remains high-R2 but its absolute error increases.
analysis.periodic_correction_interpretation: v2 C1/5/10/25/never errors remain monotonic. Absolute never-minus-C1 gap increases .464503 to .505034. Smaller never/C1 ratio is not evidence of improved stability because C1 itself worsens.
analysis.distribution_interpretation: Own-Train H50 predicted Mahalanobis RMS is lower3.441289 to2.728598, but PCA residual is higher .535272 to .559404 and reference-relative subspace deviation persists. Mixed geometry proxies do not establish off-manifold drift solved.
analysis.decoder_interpretation: Empirical sensitivity still increases with horizon; H50 ratio1.206192 versus1.198374 and decoded deviation1.162944 versus1.051632. Ratios depend on latent units and are not Jacobian norms or additive error decomposition.
analysis.gradient_interpretation: Weighted consistency never dominates observation gradient norm in an optimizer minibatch; whole-run mean ratios E/T/D .095833/.014744/0. Consistency training does not stabilize late-epoch losses; retain all60epochs, select only Validation Lobs.
analysis.latent_collapse: No global variance collapse: Train/Test effective rank12.237907/12.072160,0near-zero dimensions; all values finite. Poor composition is not hidden by prediction clipping.
analysis.hypothesis: Local consistency is an intervenable discrepancy, but its improvement is not sufficient for long-horizon accuracy under this fixedlambda stop-gradient formulation. No causal proof of a unique module root cause or a need for stochastic dynamics.
analysis.deterministic_formulation: Still worth one controlled structural test, not justified as a reliable autonomous dynamics model and not a reason to implement RSSM/Dreamer.
analysis.next_only_recommendation: Separately authorize one objective-matched autonomous multi-step latent-consistency control, rather than another lambda sweep; do not execute it in this experiment.
analysis.verification_scope: Independent reload recomputes selected-checkpoint Train/Val losses, Test diagnostics, statistics, hashes and selection. Historical training gradients/losses only receive internal consistency checks; no training replay claimed.
analysis.plot_qa: All12required figures visually inspected; long-label clipping fixed by layout-only rerender with frozen checkpoints; no metrics or model parameters changed.
